thread:
marta: quick q — can we add a lightweight 'canary cost preview' in the console so PMs and infra can see the estimated token-level + cache impact before flipping routing policies?

sam: yes please. current rollout UI only shows traffic %, not econ. folks keep surprise-ing infra with expensive canaries. :grimacing:

amy: agreed. product needs a low-friction estimator — slider for canary size and a breakdown by model + cache warmup cost. important to show 'delta vs baseline' not absolute numbers. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

pranav: backend note — estimating this needs two things: recent steady-state token mix per route + a cache-warmup model (miss->hit transition). otherwise we undercount early canary cost.

josh: i can supply a 1h/6h/24h baseline token sample per route and per-model avg tokens/pred. also can compute per-token unit cost by model variant from pricing table.

marta: ideal UX: pick routing policy change (eg prefer-low-latency), choose canary % slider, preview for time window -> shows estimated extra cost, broken down into: model delta, cache warmup amortized, cold-start GPU spin-up (if applicable).

lucas: mockup idea: three columns: steady-state baseline | immediate canary impact (0-24h) | 7-day amortized projection. show sparklines and a small tooltip explaining assumptions. can show confidence band if sample variance high.

irene: telemetry needs: kv_cache_hit_rate, cold_start_count, model_selection_histogram, tokens_generated, request_latency_p50/p95. need to surface those per-route and per-tenant. also mark when data is sparse (tenant < X reqs/hr).

pranav: proposal for cache warmup: model per-route estimate = current hit_rate H0. assume canary instances start at H_start (measured e.g., 5%) and converge to H_target = H0 over W minutes. amortize miss cost over min(traffic_estimate*W, K) requests. we should let UX choose conservative vs optimistic warmup.

josh: sample SQL to compute baseline tokens and hits: 
```sql
SELECT model, SUM(tokens) as tokens, AVG(kv_hit::int) as hit_rate
FROM route_events
WHERE route='search-v2' AND ts >= now()-interval '6 hour'
GROUP BY model;
```

pranav: and pseudo API for estimator: 
```http
POST /v1/internal/costs/estimate
{
  "route":"search-v2",
  "change": {"routing_policy":"prefer-low-latency","percent":20},
  "window":"24h",
  "warmup_policy":"conservative"
}
```

marta: UX question — do we show per-tenant dollar estimates by default? feels risky on privacy / noise for small tenants. maybe gated to > $X/month or opt-in.

amy: yes gated. default: show absolute and percent change for org-level and anonymized sample for small tenants. billing-visible only for billing admins.

lucas: for the console, small inline explainer: "Estimates use recent traffic and a warmup model; actuals may differ. Use canary to validate." a small 'run dry-run' button that kicks off a short live simulation (sampling only) could help.

pranav: implementation notes: estimator will be a best-effort aggregator reading recent telemetry (stream), a cost model store (per-model unit costs), and a warmup policy engine. should run fast (<2s) for interactive UX; fallback to async job if data window large.

josh: i'll add a new materialized view with per-route 5m rollups for tokens + hits to keep estimator lightweight.

marta: action items: pranav prototype backend estimate (POC lambda) by EOW; lucas do 2 small mocks (conservative/optimistic) by Tue; josh add rollup by EOD; irene add kv_hit_rate and cold_start_count flags to rollup. amy to decide gating policy.

pranav: ack assigning now. will stub an endpoint and return both optimistic/conservative numbers.

amy: :thumbsup: let's avoid dollars for now in public UI — show token delta + estimated $ for billing admins only.

deploy-bot: canary-started: deployment search-v2-canary-2024-07-14T16:02 :rocket:

marta: nice — once canary runs can we compare predicted vs actual in the same panel? immediate feedback loop would be great for confidence.

pranav: yep — plan to store estimator input + output for that canary_id and compute error after 1h/6h windows. we can surface a small 'prediction accuracy' badge.

marta: great. thanks all. keeping this thread for sync notes and final checklist.

sam: thanks — this should reduce surprise tickets a lot. :pray:
